definition_en: the organ that digests food, or the front of the body below the chest
core_image: 一个微微鼓起的袋子装满了食物
scene: 他吃得太快，胃开始疼。He ate too fast and his stomach hurt.
sceneCN: 这里 stomach 是「胃」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他吃得太快，胃开始疼。

senses.title: The digestive organ
senses.definition: the organ in the body where food is digested
senses.definitionCN: 体内消化食物的器官
senses.example: His stomach hurt after lunch.
senses.why: This is the basic organ sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的器官义项。

senses.title: The belly
senses.definition: the front part of the body below the chest
senses.definitionCN: 胸部以下的身体前部
senses.example: The ball hit him in the stomach.
senses.why: The organ names the whole area around it.
senses.whyCN: 器官的名称转指它周围的整片区域。

senses.title: Bear something
senses.definition: to accept or bear something unpleasant
senses.definitionCN: 接受或忍受令人不快的事
senses.example: I cannot stomach such rudeness.
senses.why: The stomach as the seat of feeling gives a verb.
senses.whyCN: 胃被视为情绪之所，由此引申出动词。

intro.en: Stomach travelled from Greek through Latin and French into English.
intro.cn: stomach 从希腊语经拉丁语和法语传入英语。

items.en: Stomachos named the mouth of the stomach.
Latin stomachus named the organ and temper.
items.cn: 拉丁语 stomachus 既指器官，也指性情。

items.en: Old French estomac carried the word onward.
items.cn: 古法语 estomac 把这个词继续传递下去。

items.en: Stomach meant the organ, appetite, and anger.
items.cn: stomach 既指器官，也指食欲与怒气。

items.en: Stomach also came to mean the belly.

note.en: Stomach is compared with look-alike words and with words for the belly.
note.cn: 把 stomach 与形近词以及表示腹部的词作比较。

entries.definition: the front of the body below the chest
an informal word for the stomach

normalIntro.en: The stomach is a bag that turns food into strength.
normalIntro.cn: 胃是一个把食物变成力气的袋子。

normal.en: My stomach is full.
Do not swim on a full stomach.
A stomach ache kept her home.
The smell turned my stomach.
He has no stomach for quarrels.

abstract.en: The stomach is the body's quiet kitchen.
abstract.cn: 胃是身体里安静的厨房。

abstract.en: Courage was once thought to sit in the stomach.
abstract.cn: 古人曾以为勇气住在胃里。

abstract.en: What we cannot stomach, we cannot swallow.
abstract.cn: 咽不下去的东西，也忍受不了。

examples.en: He ate too fast and his stomach hurt.
The ball hit him in the stomach.
I cannot stomach such rudeness.

dict_mnemonic.text: stomach 是「胃」，也指「腹部」；stomach ache 是胃痛，on an empty stomach 是空腹，have no stomach for 是对某事没兴趣或没胆量。

root: 源自希腊语 stomachos（胃的开口），经拉丁语 stomachus 与古法语 estomac 进入英语；由器官本身，引申为腹部，再引申为「忍受」这一心理动作。

sensesIntro.en: Stomach is the digestive organ, the belly, or the ability to bear something.
sensesIntro.cn: stomach 是消化器官、腹部，或忍受某事的能力。

core.en: A soft bag that receives food.
core.cn: 一个接收食物的柔软袋子。

branches.en: His stomach hurt after lunch.
branches.cn: 午饭后他的胃疼。

branches.en: The ball hit him in the stomach.
branches.cn: 球打在他的腹部。

branches.en: I cannot stomach such rudeness.
branches.cn: 我受不了这种无礼。

branches.en: Organ and belly share one word.
branches.cn: 器官与腹部共用同一个词。

branches.en: What the belly rejects, the mind refuses.
branches.cn: 肚子排斥的，心里也拒绝。

intro.en: Stomach takes endings and builds words about the belly.
intro.cn: stomach 加词尾，构成与腹部相关的词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin form stomachus sits behind the English word.
latinIntro.cn: 英语这个词背后是拉丁语形式 stomachus。

items.example: She is not stomaching the noise.
Do not take it on an empty stomach.
He has no stomach for fighting.

latinEntries.meaning: the gullet, the organ, and temper
latinEntries.example: The Latin word covered the organ and the mood.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 这个拉丁词兼指器官与情绪。

definition_en: a hard piece of rock, rock used for building, or the hard seed of a fruit
core_image: 一块被溪水磨得光滑的灰色石头
scene: 孩子们在河边捡石头。The children picked up stones by the river.
sceneCN: 这里 stone 是「石头」（第 1 个义项）；句意：孩子们在河边捡石头。

senses.title: A piece of rock
senses.definition: a hard solid piece of rock
senses.definitionCN: 一块坚硬的岩石
senses.example: The children picked up stones.
senses.why: This is the basic object sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的实物义项。

senses.title: Building rock
senses.definition: rock cut and used as a building material
senses.definitionCN: 切割后用作建筑材料的岩石
senses.example: The house is built of stone.
senses.why: The material takes the name of its pieces.
senses.whyCN: 材料沿用了石块的名字。

senses.title: The seed of fruit
senses.definition: the hard seed inside a fruit
senses.definitionCN: 水果内部坚硬的种子
senses.example: He removed the stone from the peach.
senses.why: The hard seed looks like a small stone.
senses.whyCN: 坚硬的果核像一块小石头。

senses.title: A hard mass in the body
senses.definition: a small hard mass that forms inside the body
senses.definitionCN: 体内形成的小硬块
senses.example: He passed a kidney stone.
senses.why: The body forms its own small stones.
senses.whyCN: 身体自己也会长出不小的石头。

intro.en: Stone is one of the oldest Germanic words in English.
intro.cn: stone 是英语中最古老的日耳曼语词之一。

items.en: The root named hard rock.
Old English stan meant a stone.
items.cn: 古英语 stan 指石头。

items.en: Stone also named building material.
Stone named the hard seed of fruit.
Stone named hard masses in the body.

note.en: Stone is compared with look-alike words and with words for rock.
note.cn: 把 stone 与形近词以及表示岩石的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Stone is hard, heavy, and older than anything built from it.
normalIntro.cn: 石头坚硬、沉重，比用它建成的任何东西都古老。

normal.en: The stone is heavy.
The wall is made of stone.
The peach has a hard stone.
They left no stone unturned.
The school is a stone's throw away.

abstract.en: A stone remembers every hand that lifted it.
abstract.cn: 石头记得每一双搬过它的手。

abstract.en: Hard stone, soft water, and time wins.
abstract.cn: 硬石头，软流水，时间最后赢。

abstract.en: A heart of stone feels nothing, which is not a gift.
abstract.cn: 铁石心肠什么都感受不到，这并非恩赐。

examples.en: The children picked up stones by the river.
The house is built of stone.
He removed the stone from the peach.

dict_mnemonic.text: stone 是「石头」，也指「石料」「果核」「结石」；a stone's throw 是一箭之遥，leave no stone unturned 是想尽一切办法。

root: 来自古英语 stan（石头），与日耳曼语同源；由坚硬的岩石，引申为建筑材料，再由「硬块」的形象引申出果核与体内结石。

sensesIntro.en: Stone is a piece of rock, building rock, the hard seed of fruit, or a hard mass in the body.
sensesIntro.cn: stone 是石头、石料、果核，或体内的结石。

core.en: Hard matter that outlasts soft hands.
core.cn: 比柔软的手更久存的坚硬物质。

branches.en: The children picked up stones.
branches.cn: 孩子们捡起了石头。

branches.en: The house is built of stone.
branches.cn: 这房子是用石头建的。

branches.en: He removed the stone from the peach.
branches.cn: 他把桃核取了出来。

branches.en: He passed a kidney stone.
branches.cn: 他排出了一颗肾结石。

branches.en: Loose stones become a solid wall.
branches.cn: 散落的石头变成坚固的墙。

intro.en: Stone takes endings and builds words for rock and hardness.
intro.cn: stone 加词尾，构成与岩石和坚硬相关的词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.example: The path is full of stones.
The stoniness of the soil surprised us.
items.exampleCN: 土壤之多石让我们吃惊。

items.meaning: the early age of stone tools
items.example: People used stone tools in the Stone Age.
items.exampleCN: 石器时代的人使用石制工具。

items.meaning: a hard mass in the kidney

definition_en: to bend the body forward and down, to lower oneself, or a small porch
core_image: 一个人弓着背俯身拾起地上的东西
scene: 他弯腰捡起钥匙。He stooped to pick up the key.
sceneCN: 这里 stoop 是「弯腰」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他弯腰捡起钥匙。

senses.title: Bend down
senses.definition: to bend the body forward and down
senses.definitionCN: 身体向前下方弯曲
senses.example: He stooped to pick up the key.
senses.why: This is the basic bodily action.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的身体动作。

senses.title: Lower oneself
senses.definition: to lower oneself to do something wrong or unworthy
senses.definitionCN: 自降身份去做错误或不体面的事
senses.example: She would never stoop to lying.
senses.why: Bending the body becomes bending one's standards.
senses.whyCN: 弯下身体，引申为降低标准。

senses.title: A small porch
senses.definition: a small porch with steps at the entrance of a house
senses.definitionCN: 房屋入口带台阶的小门廊
senses.example: They sat on the stoop and talked.
senses.exampleCN: 他们坐在门前台阶上聊天。
senses.why: The place where one steps down takes the name.
senses.whyCN: 人走下的那处台阶沿用了这个词。

intro.en: Stoop comes from an Old English verb for bowing.
intro.cn: stoop 来自一个表示低头的古英语动词。

items.en: The root meant to bow or bend.
items.cn: 该词根意为低头或弯曲。

items.en: Old English stupian meant to bow down.
items.cn: 古英语 stupian 意为俯身低头。

items.en: Stoop named the bent posture.
Stoop to meant to lower oneself.
items.cn: stoop to 表示自降身份。

items.en: Stoop named a porch in American English.
items.cn: stoop 在美式英语中指门廊。

note.en: Stoop is compared with look-alike words and with words for bending.
note.cn: 把 stoop 与形近词以及表示弯曲的词作比较。

entries.definition: to bend the head or body

normalIntro.en: To stoop is to bring your head nearer the ground.
normalIntro.cn: stoop 就是把头靠近地面。

normal.en: He stooped to tie his shoe.
Do not stoop for long.
She stooped over the baby.
He would not stoop to cheat.
They sat on the stoop at dusk.
normal.cn: 黄昏时他们坐在门前台阶上。

abstract.en: Stooping to lift another is not a loss of height.
abstract.cn: 弯腰去扶别人，并不算矮了一截。

abstract.en: Some people stoop only to pick up what they dropped.
abstract.cn: 有些人弯腰，只是为了捡回自己丢掉的东西。

abstract.en: A bent back can still carry a straight heart.
abstract.cn: 弯下的背，仍能扛着一颗挺直的心。

examples.en: He stooped to pick up the key.
She would never stoop to lying.
They sat on the stoop and talked.
examples.cn: 他们坐在门前台阶上聊天。

dict_mnemonic.text: stoop 是「弯腰」，stoop to 是屈尊或堕落到做某事；名词 stoop 在美式英语里指门前的台阶与门廊。

root: 来自古英语 stupian（俯身低头），与日耳曼语同源；由身体的下弯，引申为身份与品格的降低，名词又指人进出门时走上走下的台阶门廊。

sensesIntro.en: Stoop is to bend down, to lower oneself, or a small entrance porch.
sensesIntro.cn: stoop 是弯腰、自降身份，或入口处的小门廊。

core.en: A body folded toward the ground.
core.cn: 一具朝地面折下的身体。

branches.en: He stooped to pick up the key.
branches.cn: 他弯腰捡起钥匙。

branches.en: She would never stoop to lying.
branches.cn: 她绝不会堕落到撒谎。

branches.en: They sat on the stoop and talked.
branches.cn: 他们坐在门前台阶上聊天。

branches.en: The body bends, and so do standards.
branches.cn: 身体弯下去，标准也跟着弯。

branches.en: The porch is where you stoop to enter.
branches.cn: 门廊，正是你低头进门的地方。

intro.en: Stoop takes endings and builds phrases of bending.
intro.cn: stoop 加词尾，并构成表示弯腰的短语。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.example: She stooped to tie her shoe.
He walked with a stooping back.
He would not stoop to cheat.
They sat on the front stoop.

definition_en: to cease moving or doing something, to block, or a place where a bus stops
core_image: 一只抬起的手掌挡住前行的脚步
scene: 红灯亮了，汽车停了下来。The light turned red and the car stopped.
sceneCN: 这里 stop 是「停止」（第 1 个义项）；句意：红灯亮了，汽车停了下来。

senses.title: Cease moving
senses.definition: to cease moving or doing something
senses.definitionCN: 停止移动或停止做某事
senses.example: The car stopped at the light.
senses.why: This is the basic sense of halting.
senses.whyCN: 这是表示停止的基本义项。

senses.title: Prevent
senses.definition: to prevent something from happening or continuing
senses.definitionCN: 阻止某事发生或继续
senses.example: They stopped the leak in time.
senses.why: Halting an action becomes preventing it.
senses.whyCN: 让动作停下，引申为阻止。

senses.title: Plug a hole
senses.definition: to block a hole or passage
senses.definitionCN: 堵住孔洞或通道
senses.example: He stopped the bottle with a cork.
senses.exampleCN: 他用软木塞塞住了瓶子。
senses.why: The oldest sense was to plug with tow.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项正是用麻絮塞住。

senses.title: A bus stop
senses.definition: a place where a bus or train picks up people
senses.definitionCN: 公交车或火车上下客的地方
senses.example: We met at the bus stop.
senses.why: The place where motion stops takes the name.
senses.whyCN: 运动停下的地点沿用了这个词。

intro.en: Stop first meant to plug a hole, then to halt.
intro.cn: stop 最初表示塞住孔洞，后来才表示停下。

items.en: Latin stuppa meant tow, coarse fibre.
items.cn: 拉丁语 stuppa 指麻絮、粗纤维。

items.en: Stoppian meant to plug with tow.
Stop broadened to mean to halt.
items.cn: stop 的词义扩展为停下。

items.en: Stop also meant to prevent.
A stop became a place for buses.
items.cn: stop 成为公交车站的名称。

note.en: Stop is compared with look-alike words and with words for halting.
note.cn: 把 stop 与形近词以及表示停止的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Stop is a hand raised against motion.
normalIntro.cn: stop 是一只对着运动举起的手。

normal.en: The bus stops here.
Stop talking, please.
We stopped to rest.
The cork stops the bottle.
I will stop by after work.

abstract.en: A stop is a small promise to look before going on.
abstract.cn: 停一下，是继续之前先看一眼的小小承诺。

abstract.en: Some stops are endings and some are breaths.
abstract.cn: 有些停下是终结，有些只是呼吸。

abstract.en: You cannot stop the river, only choose where to stand.
abstract.cn: 你拦不住河水，只能选择站在哪里。

examples.en: The light turned red and the car stopped.
examples.cn: 红灯亮了，汽车停了下来。

examples.en: They stopped the leak in time.
We met at the bus stop.

dict_mnemonic.text: stop 是「停止」；stop doing 是停止做，stop to do 是停下来去做，bus stop 是公交车站，put a stop to 是制止某事。

root: 可追溯至拉丁语 stuppa（麻絮），古英语 stoppian 本义是「用麻絮塞住」；由堵塞孔洞，引申为让运动与行为停下，再引申为阻止与车站。

sensesIntro.en: Stop means to halt, to prevent, to plug, or a place where vehicles halt.
sensesIntro.cn: stop 表示停下、阻止、堵塞，或车辆停靠的车站。

core.en: Motion meeting a wall.
core.cn: 运动撞上了一堵墙。

branches.en: The car stopped at the light.
branches.cn: 汽车在红灯前停下。

branches.en: They stopped the leak in time.
branches.cn: 他们及时止住了漏水。

branches.en: He stopped the bottle with a cork.
branches.cn: 他用软木塞塞住了瓶子。

branches.en: We met at the bus stop.
branches.cn: 我们在公交车站见面。

branches.en: The stop is where the stopping happens.
branches.cn: 车站，正是停车发生的地方。

intro.en: Stop doubles its final letter and builds words for halting.
intro.cn: stop 变化时双写词尾，并构成表示停止的词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source stuppa meant tow used for plugging.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语来源 stuppa 指用来堵塞的麻絮。

items.example: Put the stopper in the bottle.
We met at the bus stop.

latinEntries.structure: Latin stuppa to Old English stoppian
latinEntries.example: The earliest stop was a plug.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 最早的 stop 就是一个塞子。

definition_zh: 贮藏；储存；仓储；存储空间
definition_en: the act of keeping things until needed, or the space used for this
core_image: 码到屋顶的纸箱和一排上好锁的柜子
scene: 这些箱子被放进仓库储存。The boxes are kept in storage.
sceneCN: 这里 storage 是「贮藏」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这些箱子被放进仓库储存。

senses.title: Keeping things
senses.definition: the act of keeping things until they are needed
senses.definitionCN: 把东西留到需要时再用的行为
senses.example: The boxes are kept in storage.
senses.why: This is the core sense of keeping.
senses.whyCN: 这是表示存放的核心义项。

senses.title: Space for keeping
senses.definition: space used for keeping things
senses.definitionCN: 用来存放物品的空间
senses.example: We need more storage in the kitchen.
senses.exampleCN: 厨房里我们需要更多储存空间。
senses.why: The action names the room it needs.
senses.whyCN: 这个行为也指它所需的空间。

senses.title: Digital memory
senses.definition: the keeping of data in a computer
senses.definitionCN: 在计算机中保存数据
senses.example: The phone has plenty of storage.
senses.exampleCN: 这部手机有很大的存储空间。
senses.why: Digital memory repeats the old image.
senses.whyCN: 数字记忆重复了古老的存放意象。

intro.en: Storage is store plus the suffix age.
intro.cn: storage 由 store 加后缀 age 构成。

items.en: Latin instaurare meant to set up or renew.
items.cn: 拉丁语 instaurare 意为建立或更新。

items.en: Estorer meant to furnish or supply.
Store meant a supply kept ready.
The suffix age formed storage.
items.cn: 后缀 age 构成了 storage。

items.en: Storage spread to computers.
items.cn: storage 扩展到计算机领域。

note.en: Storage is compared with look-alike words and with words for keeping.
note.cn: 把 storage 与形近词以及表示保存的词作比较。

entries.definition: the storing of goods in a warehouse

normalIntro.en: Storage is where things wait until you need them.
normalIntro.cn: storage 就是东西等着你取用的地方。

normal.en: The chairs are in storage.
We need more storage space.
normal.cn: 我们需要更多储存空间。

normal.en: Fruit goes into cold storage.
Data storage is cheap now.
The storeroom is locked.

abstract.en: Storage is a promise that the future will need the past.
abstract.cn: 储存，是一个相信将来仍需要过去的承诺。

abstract.en: We store what we fear to lose.
abstract.cn: 我们存放的，都是怕失去的东西。

abstract.en: Memory is storage without shelves.
abstract.cn: 记忆，是没有货架的储存。

examples.en: The boxes are kept in storage.
We need more storage in the kitchen.
examples.cn: 厨房里我们需要更多储存空间。

examples.en: The phone has plenty of storage.
examples.cn: 这部手机有很大的存储空间。

dict_mnemonic.text: storage 是 store 加后缀 age，表示「贮藏、储存」；storage space 是储存空间，in storage 是存放着，data storage 是数据存储。

root: 由 store 加后缀 age 构成；store 经古法语 estorer（置备）来自拉丁语 instaurare（建立、更新），因此 storage 字面就是「置备起来的状态」。

sensesIntro.en: Storage is the keeping of things, the space for it, or digital memory.
sensesIntro.cn: storage 是物品的存放、存放所需的空间，或数字存储。

core.en: Things set aside and kept safe.
core.cn: 被放到一边、妥善保管的东西。

branches.en: The boxes are kept in storage.
branches.cn: 这些箱子被存放着。

branches.en: We need more storage in the kitchen.
branches.cn: 厨房里我们需要更多储存空间。

branches.en: The phone has plenty of storage.
branches.cn: 这部手机有很大的存储空间。

branches.en: Keeping needs a place to keep things.
branches.cn: 存放需要有地方放东西。

definition_en: a shop, a supply kept for future use, or to keep something for later
core_image: 货架后面堆满货物的库房
scene: 这家店周末很忙。The store is busy on weekends.
sceneCN: 这里 store 是「商店」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这家店周末很忙。

senses.title: A shop
senses.definition: a shop where goods are sold
senses.definitionCN: 出售商品的店铺
senses.example: The store opens at nine.
senses.why: This is the everyday American sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是美式英语中日常的商店义项。

senses.title: A supply kept
senses.definition: a supply of something kept for future use
senses.definitionCN: 留待将来使用的储备
senses.example: They keep a store of wood.
senses.why: The shop and the stock share one idea of keeping.
senses.whyCN: 商店与存货共享「存放」这一概念。

senses.title: Keep for later
senses.definition: to keep something for future use
senses.definitionCN: 把某物留待将来使用
senses.example: We stored the boxes in the attic.
senses.exampleCN: 我们把箱子存在阁楼里。
senses.why: The noun turns into the act of keeping.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为存放的动作。

intro.en: Store came through Old French from a Latin verb for setting up.
intro.cn: store 经古法语来自一个表示建立的拉丁语动词。

items.en: Instaurare meant to set up or renew.
Estorer meant to furnish or supply.
Store named a supply kept ready.
Store named a shop in America.
items.cn: store 在美式英语中指商店。

items.en: Store spread to data kept on machines.
items.cn: store 扩展到机器保存的数据。

note.en: Store is compared with look-alike words and with words for shops and supplies.
note.cn: 把 store 与形近词以及表示商店和储备的词作比较。

entries.definition: a place where goods are sold

normalIntro.en: A store sells what it keeps, and keeps what it sells.
normalIntro.cn: 商店卖它存的东西，也存它要卖的东西。

normal.en: The store is busy on weekends.
Store the rice in a dry place.
normal.cn: 把米存放在干燥的地方。

normal.en: They store up food for winter.
There is a surprise in store for you.
The phone stores thousands of photos.
normal.cn: 这部手机存着数千张照片。

abstract.en: A store is a promise made to tomorrow.
abstract.cn: 商店，是向明天许下的承诺。

abstract.en: We store what we cannot yet use.
abstract.cn: 我们存放的，是暂时用不上的东西。

abstract.en: Every shelf holds a small future.
abstract.cn: 每一层货架，都托着一点未来。

examples.en: The store is busy on weekends.
They keep a store of wood.
We stored the boxes in the attic.
examples.cn: 我们把箱子存在阁楼里。

dict_mnemonic.text: store 是「商店」，也指「储备」和「储存」；department store 是百货商店，store up 是储备，in store 是储备着或即将发生。

root: 经古法语 estorer（置备、供给）来自拉丁语 instaurare（建立、更新）；由置备物资，引申为储备、储存，再指售货的商店。

sensesIntro.en: Store is a shop, a supply kept ready, or the act of keeping something.
sensesIntro.cn: store 是商店、备好的储备，或储存的行为。

core.en: Goods held until someone needs them.
core.cn: 货物被存着，直到有人需要。

branches.en: The store opens at nine.
branches.cn: 这家店九点开门。

branches.en: They keep a store of wood.
branches.cn: 他们存着一批木柴。

branches.en: We stored the boxes in the attic.
branches.cn: 我们把箱子存在阁楼里。

branches.en: A shop is simply a store of goods on show.
branches.cn: 商店不过是将存货摆出来给人看。

branches.en: To store is to build a store for later.
branches.cn: 储存，就是为以后备下一份库存。

intro.en: Store takes endings and builds words for shops and keeping.
intro.cn: store 加词尾，构成与商店和存放相关的词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source instaurare meant to set up or renew.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语来源 instaurare 意为建立或更新。

items.exampleCN: 储存谷物需要干燥的空气。

items.meaning: a large shop with many sections

items.exampleCN: 她在一家百货商店工作。

definition_zh: 暴风雨；风暴；猛攻；怒气冲冲地走
definition_en: very bad weather with strong wind and rain, a violent outbreak, or to attack suddenly
core_image: 乌云压城，狂风掀起了海面
scene: 暴风雨掀翻了屋顶。The storm blew off the roof.
sceneCN: 这里 storm 是「暴风雨」（第 1 个义项）；句意：暴风雨掀翻了屋顶。

senses.title: Bad weather
senses.definition: very bad weather with strong wind and heavy rain
senses.definitionCN: 狂风暴雨的恶劣天气
senses.example: The storm blew off the roof.
senses.why: This is the basic weather sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的天气义项。

senses.title: A violent outbreak
senses.definition: a sudden violent show of feeling or protest
senses.definitionCN: 情绪或抗议的突然猛烈爆发
senses.example: A storm of protest followed.
senses.why: Weather becomes a picture for feelings.
senses.whyCN: 天气成为情绪的比喻。

senses.title: Attack suddenly
senses.definition: to attack a place suddenly and violently
senses.definitionCN: 突然而猛烈地攻击某地
senses.example: The soldiers stormed the gate.
senses.why: The force of weather becomes the force of attack.
senses.whyCN: 天气的威力转成攻击的威力。

senses.title: Leave in anger
senses.definition: to go somewhere in a very angry way
senses.definitionCN: 非常愤怒地走向某处
senses.example: She stormed out of the room.
senses.exampleCN: 她怒气冲冲地离开了房间。
senses.why: Anger moves like a storm.
senses.whyCN: 怒气像风暴一样移动。

intro.en: Storm is an old Germanic word for violent weather.
intro.cn: storm 是一个古老的日耳曼语词，指猛烈的天气。

items.en: The root named a violent rush.
Storm meant a tempest of wind and rain.
items.cn: storm 指风雨交加的暴风雨。

items.en: Storm also meant an attack.
Storm pictured outbreaks of feeling.
items.cn: storm 用来比喻情绪的爆发。

items.en: To storm out meant to leave in anger.
items.cn: storm out 意为怒气冲冲地离开。

note.en: Storm is compared with look-alike words and with words for violent weather.
note.cn: 把 storm 与形近词以及表示猛烈天气的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: A storm is weather with a temper.
normalIntro.cn: storm 是带着脾气的天气。

normal.en: The storm blew off the roof.
A storm of protest followed.
The soldiers stormed the gate.
She stormed out of the room.
normal.cn: 她怒气冲冲地离开了房间。

normal.en: The ship weathered the storm.

abstract.en: A storm is the sky losing its patience.
abstract.cn: 风暴，是天空失去了耐心。

abstract.en: Anger is a storm that breaks inside a room.
abstract.cn: 愤怒，是在屋里爆发的风暴。

abstract.en: After every storm the air feels newly washed.
abstract.cn: 每场风暴过后，空气都像被重新洗过。

examples.en: The storm blew off the roof.
A storm of protest followed.
She stormed out of the room.
examples.cn: 她怒气冲冲地离开了房间。

dict_mnemonic.text: storm 是「暴风雨」，也指情绪或抗议的风暴；take by storm 是迅速攻占或风靡，storm out 是怒气冲冲地离开，weather the storm 是渡过难关。

root: 来自古英语 storm（风雨交加），与日耳曼语同源；由自然界的猛烈天气，引申为情绪与舆论的爆发，再引申为猛攻与愤然离去。

sensesIntro.en: Storm is violent weather, an outbreak of feeling, a sudden attack, or an angry exit.
sensesIntro.cn: storm 是猛烈天气、情绪爆发、突然猛攻，或愤然离开。

core.en: Force that arrives all at once.
core.cn: 一下子全部到来的力量。

branches.en: The storm blew off the roof.
branches.cn: 暴风雨掀翻了屋顶。

branches.en: A storm of protest followed.
branches.cn: 随后爆发了一片抗议。

branches.en: The soldiers stormed the gate.
branches.cn: 士兵们猛攻大门。

branches.en: She stormed out of the room.
branches.cn: 她怒气冲冲地离开了房间。

branches.en: The same anger sounds in protest and in footsteps.
branches.cn: 同样的怒气，响在抗议里，也响在脚步里。

intro.en: Storm takes endings and builds words for wild weather and feeling.
intro.cn: storm 加词尾，构成与恶劣天气和情绪相关的词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.example: The troops were storming the hill.
A stormy night kept them indoors.
items.exampleCN: 暴风雨的夜晚让他们留在室内。

items.example: The storminess of the sea kept boats in port.
items.exampleCN: 海上的风暴使船只留在港内。

items.meaning: a warning of a coming storm

definition_en: a description of events, a news report, or a level of a building
core_image: 一盏灯下摊开的旧故事书
scene: 奶奶每晚给我们讲一个故事。Grandma tells us a story every night.
sceneCN: 这里 story 是「故事」（第 1 个义项）；句意：奶奶每晚给我们讲一个故事。

derivatives.zh: 有故事流传的；历史上有名的

senses.title: A told tale
senses.definition: a description of events, real or imagined
senses.definitionCN: 对真实或想象事件的叙述
senses.example: Grandma tells us a story every night.
senses.exampleCN: 奶奶每晚给我们讲一个故事。
senses.why: This is the basic sense of a tale.
senses.whyCN: 这是故事的基本义项。

senses.title: A news report
senses.definition: a report of events in a newspaper or broadcast
senses.definitionCN: 报纸或广播中的事件报道
senses.example: The paper ran the story on page one.
senses.exampleCN: 报纸把这条报道放在头版。
senses.why: News is a story told about real events.
senses.whyCN: 新闻就是关于真实事件的叙述。

senses.title: A level of a building
senses.definition: a level or floor of a building
senses.definitionCN: 建筑物的一层
senses.example: They live in a two-story house.
senses.exampleCN: 他们住在一栋两层的房子里。
senses.why: Each floor once held painted scenes.
senses.whyCN: 古时每层楼常绘有图画故事。

intro.en: Story comes from Latin historia by way of French.
intro.cn: story 经法语来自拉丁语 historia。

items.en: Historia meant inquiry and narrative.
Estorie meant a tale or account.
Story named a tale and a history.
Story named a news report.
Story named a floor of a building.

note.en: Story is compared with look-alike words and with words for tales.
note.cn: 把 story 与形近词以及表示故事的词作比较。

entries.definition: a bright point in the night sky

normalIntro.en: A story gives events a shape you can carry.
normalIntro.cn: 故事把事件整理成能带走的形状。

normal.en: Grandma tells us a story every night.
normal.cn: 奶奶每晚给我们讲一个故事。

normal.en: He read a short story on the train.
normal.cn: 他在火车上读了一篇短篇小说。

normal.en: The paper ran the story on page one.
normal.cn: 报纸把这条报道放在头版。

normal.en: They live in a two-story house.
normal.cn: 他们住在一栋两层的房子里。

normal.en: The story goes that she never returned.

abstract.en: A story is a room built out of words.
abstract.cn: 故事，是用词语搭起来的一间屋子。

abstract.en: We are all stories still being written.
abstract.cn: 我们都还是正在被书写的故事。

abstract.en: The same events tell a different story to each listener.
abstract.cn: 同样的事件，对每个听者讲出不同的故事。

examples.en: Grandma tells us a story every night.
examples.cn: 奶奶每晚给我们讲一个故事。

examples.en: The paper ran the story on page one.
examples.cn: 报纸把这条报道放在头版。

examples.en: They live in a two-story house.
examples.cn: 他们住在一栋两层的房子里。

dict_mnemonic.text: story 是「故事、小说」；tell a story 是讲故事，news story 是新闻报道，two-story house 是两层的房子，词尾的 story 在美式英语里就是「楼层」。

root: 经古法语 estorie 来自拉丁语 historia（探究、叙述）；由对真实事件的记述，兼指虚构的故事，再引申为新闻篇幅与建筑物的楼层。

sensesIntro.en: Story is a tale, a news report, or a level of a building.
sensesIntro.cn: story 是故事、新闻报道，或建筑物的楼层。

core.en: Events arranged so they can be told.
core.cn: 被整理成可以讲述的事件。

branches.en: Grandma tells us a story every night.
branches.cn: 奶奶每晚给我们讲一个故事。

branches.en: The paper ran the story on page one.
branches.cn: 报纸把这条报道放在头版。

branches.en: They live in a two-story house.
branches.cn: 他们住在一栋两层的房子里。

branches.en: News is the same telling art used on facts.
branches.cn: 新闻，是把讲故事的技艺用在事实上。

branches.en: Each floor of the old house had its own story.
branches.cn: 那栋老房子的每一层都有自己的故事。

intro.en: Story multiplies to stories and builds words for telling.
intro.cn: story 的复数变 stories，并构成与讲述相关的词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source historia meant inquiry and narrative.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语来源 historia 意为探究与叙述。

items.exampleCN: 他在火车上读了一篇短篇小说。

items.example: The news story was on page one.
They live in a two-story house.
items.exampleCN: 他们住在一栋两层的房子里。

definition_en: an appliance that burns fuel or uses electricity to cook food or heat a room
core_image: 一口冒着白汽的锅坐在通红的炉眼上
scene: 炉子上的水壶正冒着热气。The kettle on the stove is steaming.
sceneCN: 这里 stove 是「炉子」（第 1 个义项）；句意：炉子上的水壶正冒着热气。

senses.title: A cooking stove
senses.definition: an appliance used for cooking food
senses.definitionCN: 用来烹煮食物的器具
senses.example: The kettle is on the stove.
senses.why: This is the everyday kitchen sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是日常厨房里的义项。

senses.title: A room heater
senses.definition: a closed fire used to heat a room
senses.definitionCN: 用来给房间取暖的封闭火炉
senses.example: They gathered around the stove.
senses.why: The oldest sense was a heated room.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项正是暖和的房间。

intro.en: Stove first meant a heated room, not a cooker.
intro.cn: stove 最初指暖和的房间，而不是炉灶。

items.en: The root named a heated room.
Middle Dutch stove meant a heated room.
items.cn: 中古荷兰语 stove 指温暖的房间。

items.en: Stove first meant a warm room or bath.
items.cn: stove 最初指暖房或浴室。

items.en: Stove became a cooking appliance.
Stove also named a room heater.

note.en: Stove is compared with look-alike words and with words for heating and cooking.
note.cn: 把 stove 与形近词以及表示加热与烹饪的词作比较。

entries.definition: a device that warms a room

normalIntro.en: A stove is a small fire you can command.
normalIntro.cn: stove 是一小团你能指挥的火。

normal.en: The kettle is on the stove.
She cooks on a gas stove.
They gathered around the stove.
Wipe the stove top after cooking.
A wood stove warmed the whole room.
normal.cn: 一个柴火炉暖了整个房间。

abstract.en: A stove turns fuel into warmth and food.
abstract.cn: 炉子把燃料变成温暖与食物。

abstract.en: The oldest stove was simply a warm room.
abstract.cn: 最古老的炉子，不过是一间暖屋。

abstract.en: Fire kept in a box is called comfort.
abstract.cn: 关在箱子里的火，叫做舒适。

examples.en: The kettle on the stove is steaming.
examples.cn: 炉子上的水壶正冒着热气。

examples.en: She cooks on a gas stove.
They gathered around the stove.

dict_mnemonic.text: stove 是「炉子」；gas stove 是煤气炉，electric stove 是电炉，on the stove 是在炉子上，wood stove 是柴火炉。

sensesIntro.en: Stove is a cooking appliance or a closed fire for heating a room.
sensesIntro.cn: stove 是烹饪炉灶，或给房间取暖的封闭火炉。

core.en: Fire held inside a metal box.
core.cn: 被关在金属箱里的一团火。

branches.en: The kettle is on the stove.
branches.cn: 水壶在炉子上。

branches.en: They gathered around the stove.
branches.cn: 他们围坐在火炉旁。

branches.en: One box of fire cooks and warms.
branches.cn: 一箱火，既做饭也取暖。

branches.en: A heated room became a heater.
branches.cn: 暖和的房间，变成了取暖的炉子。

branches.en: Every kitchen keeps a tame fire.
branches.cn: 每个厨房都养着一团温顺的火。

intro.en: Stove takes a plural and builds parts of the stove.
intro.cn: stove 加复数，并构成炉子的各个部件。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word came from Low German and Dutch.

items.meaning: a heated room, later a cooker
the top surface of a stove

The pot is on the stove.

definition_zh: 直的；笔直的；正直的；直接地
definition_en: not bent or curved, honest and direct, or in a direct way
core_image: 一条笔直延伸到地平线的公路
scene: 这条路又长又直。The road is long and straight.
sceneCN: 这里 straight 是「直的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这条路又长又直。

senses.title: Not bent
senses.definition: not bent or curved
senses.definitionCN: 不弯不曲的
senses.example: Draw a straight line.
senses.why: This is the basic shape sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的形状义项。

senses.title: Honest
senses.definition: honest and direct in speech or behaviour
senses.definitionCN: 言语或行为诚实直接
senses.example: Give me a straight answer.
senses.why: A straight line becomes a straight character.
senses.whyCN: 笔直的线，变成了正直的品格。

senses.title: Directly
senses.definition: in a direct way, without delay or detour
senses.definitionCN: 径直地，不耽搁也不绕路
senses.example: Go straight home after school.
senses.why: The adjective works as an adverb.
senses.whyCN: 形容词同时用作副词。

intro.en: Straight is the old past participle of stretch.
intro.cn: straight 原是 stretch（伸展）的过去分词。

items.en: The root meant to stretch tight.
Streht meant stretched out.
Straight named a line without bends.
Straight came to mean honest.
Straight worked as an adverb.
items.cn: straight 也用作副词，表示直接地。

note.en: Straight is compared with look-alike words and with words for directness.
note.cn: 把 straight 与形近词以及表示直接与正直的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Straight is a line that refuses to turn.
normalIntro.cn: straight 是一条拒绝转弯的线。

normal.en: The road is long and straight.
Draw a straight line.
Go straight home after school.
Give me a straight answer.
He kept a straight face.

abstract.en: A straight line wastes no motion.
abstract.cn: 直线不浪费动作。

abstract.en: A straight word can still cut.
abstract.cn: 坦白的话，同样能割伤人。

abstract.en: The shortest path is often the bravest.
abstract.cn: 最短的路，往往最需要勇气。

examples.en: The road is long and straight.
Give me a straight answer.
Go straight home after school.

dict_mnemonic.text: straight 是「直的」，也指「正直」和「直接地」；straight line 是直线，straight away 是立刻，keep a straight face 是板着脸忍住不笑。

root: 来自古英语 streht，是 streccan（伸展）的过去分词；由「被拉直、伸展开」的形象，引申为不弯曲、坦率正直，又兼作副词表示直接地。

sensesIntro.en: Straight is not bent, honest, or done directly.

dict_mnemonic.text: stream 是「溪流」，也指人或事物的一股、一连串；a stream of 是一连串，stream of traffic 是车流，live stream 是直播流。

root: 来自古英语 stream（水流），与日耳曼语同源；由小河的实体，引申为人流、话语与数据等一切持续不断的流动，并产生动词用法。

sensesIntro.en: Stream is a small river, a continuous flow, or to flow continuously.
sensesIntro.cn: stream 是小溪、持续的一股流动，或持续流动。

core.en: Water that keeps moving forward.
core.cn: 一直向前走的水。

branches.en: A stream runs through the woods.
branches.cn: 一条小溪从树林里流过。

branches.en: A stream of cars filled the road.
branches.cn: 车流塞满了道路。

branches.en: Sunlight streamed through the window.
branches.cn: 阳光从窗户涌进来。

branches.en: Water and traffic both find a channel.
branches.cn: 水流与车流，都会找到自己的道。

branches.en: What flows in a line becomes a stream.
branches.cn: 成线流动的东西，就成了溪流。

intro.en: Stream takes endings and builds words for flowing media.
intro.cn: stream 加词尾，构成与流动媒体相关的词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.example: Paper streamers hung from the ceiling.

items.meaning: a broadcast sent in real time
items.example: The concert was a live stream.
items.exampleCN: 那场音乐会是一次直播。
